channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility
item.description: Workers now enables Node.js compatibility by default, supports applications up to 64 mebibytes, and adds a URL-based module registry with import.meta, lazy compilation, shared code caches, and clearer errors. (2 sources: cloudflare, nodeweekly)

item.title: 1.1.1.1 now supports post-quantum DNSSEC, all 2,420 bytes of it
item.description: 1.1.1.1 now validates DNSSEC signatures using NIST’s post-quantum ML-DSA-44 algorithm. Here is how we manage 2,420-byte signatures and downgrade risks at scale. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: The Physics of Database Speed: from 300 to 1M transactions per second
item.description: A 19 minute animated explainer video on database speed. I explain low-level database concepts, identify bottlenecks, run benchmarks and optimize write throughput to hit 1 million TPS. submitted by /u/tanayvk [link] [comments] (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: High-performance Database Architecture - Interview with Tyler Cloutier
Presentation: Accelerating Performance by Incrementally Integrating Rust Into Existing Codebase
item.description: Lily Mara explains how to avoid high-risk software rewrites through incremental FFI refactoring. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: DIFF: A Relational Interface for Large-Scale Data Explanation
item.description: Abstract: A range of explanation engines assist data analysts by performing feature selection over increasingly high-volume and high-dimensional data, grouping and highlighting commonalities among data points. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: GitHub availability report: August 2026
item.description: In August, we experienced five incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services. The post GitHub availability report: August 2026 appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)

item.title: Meta's Recipe for Building Agents as "Organizational Second Brains"
item.description: Meta describes how an AI agent can be designed to capture the logic and expertise of domain experts, rather than simply storing documents or retrieving relevant information. (1 source: infoq)
